title: Good Disc - Good Kid Discs
description: Changes a lot of the discs to be GoodKidBand's songs!
body:
**This pack is unofficial, with no affiliation with Good Kid.**

Changes most of the music discs in the game to a DMCA free band titled "Good Kid", mostly including their album to celebrate the release!

Please note that some discs have two songs on them because the original discs were just too long to have one song on them.


<details>
<summary>List of songs in this resource pack:</summary>

- Rift - on Chirp
- Eastside - on Mellohi
- Coffee - on Lava Chicken
- Cicada - on Creator
- Tea Leaves - on Otherside
- Alone With Me - on Cat
- Ghost Keeper - on Pigstep
- Tornado - on Far
- Wall - on Tears
- Ginger Lemonade - on 13
- No Time To Explain + Orbit - on Blocks
- Alchemist - on Mall
- Summer - on Stal
- Bubbly - on Strad
- Everything Everything - on Ward
- Premier Inn - on Wait
- Mimi's Delivery Service - on 5
- Tell Me You Know - on Relic
- First Rate Town + Second Rate Town - Precipice
- Sleepy Hollow - on Bounce

</details>



**Good Kid Socials**

- spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/38SKxCyfrmNWqWunb9wGHP?si=1a29d178b7cc4aea
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@GoodKidband
- Vlog YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@badkidband
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/goodkidband
- Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@goodkidband
- Twitter: https://x.com/goodkidband

**This pack does work on older versions, however the names of songs won't be present. I will go back and make new packs for the older versions at some point... I am just being lazy rn**

**Please note that this pack is **NOT** perfect, as putting songs on discs is annoying. so when a song ends, there may be a big silence where the original disc should have ended, I have avoided this to the best of my ability.**
